contracts.old_wls: Published2011 Eq1/2/7/8 andTheorem3 already weighted additive score-difference fitting on observed support, arbitrary prior weights and residual decomposition; no new consistency method.
contracts.normalization: Let full-rank anchored incidence B and A=diag(delta^-1)B, y normalized. sigma-WLS min sum sigma*(As-y)^2 equals physical differences x=delta*y and c=sigma/delta². Both observation and weight transform required; c=sigma silently changes target. Elementary algebra, not new theorem.
contracts.orthogonal_family: F094 witness requires sigma>=lambda/2,sum1 and P sigma-orthogonal. Complete pairs/positive scales; natural Brouwer existence supplies no convergence algorithm. Ordinary WLS at fixed sigma already available.
contracts.general_minimax: For anchored full-rank A, arbitrary retraction P=A*T with T*A=I. Entrywise epigraph u>=+/-P and sum_f u_ef<=t minimize maxrow via generic LP. This is a RELAXATION: not necessarily any sigma-floor orthogonal projection, confidence/energy constraints absent. Its optimum is a lower bound for the restricted family, not automatically an eligible same-constraint comparator. No LP implemented or solver claim.
